blocks.text: COTABATO CITY, BARMM, Philippines — Five suspected motorcycle thieves were arrested, with one of them sustaining a minor gunshot wound to the arm following an exchange of gunfire with police authorities in Midsayap, Cotabato, on Friday, Oct. 23. Lt. Col. William Facsoy Jr, Midsayap police chief, said police personnel were responding to reports about a stolen motorcycle in Barangay Poblacion 6, which resulted to a brief shootout and the arrest of five men. Police identified the suspects as Samser Culnita Abidin, 18; Korsad Mohamad Kamal, 18, who sustained an injury to his left arm; Mos Buagas Mampao, 21; Alshariff Kasan Abidin, […]...
